title: Top Ten Sports for Kids in the UK

sports.name: Football (Soccer)
sports.notes: By far the most popular, with millions of children playing in school and club teams

sports.name: Swimming
sports.notes: Widely participated in through school programs and leisure centres

sports.name: Athletics
sports.notes: Track and field events popular through school sports days and clubs

sports.name: Cricket
sports.notes: Especially popular in summer, with strong junior club networks

sports.name: Rugby
sports.notes: Both union and league have strong youth programs, particularly in Wales, England, and Scotland

sports.name: Tennis
sports.notes: Boosted by Wimbledon, with LTA junior programs widely available

sports.name: Gymnastics
sports.notes: One of the fastest-growing sports for young children, especially girls

sports.name: Cycling
sports.notes: Recreational and competitive, supported by British Cycling's Go-Ride program

sports.name: Netball
sports.notes: Hugely popular with girls in schools across the UK

sports.name: Martial Arts
sports.notes: Karate, judo, and taekwondo all have large junior participation numbers
